DESCRIPTION:Speaker(s): #RAC #Learning #ImpactWe warmly invite you to an inspiring dinner hosted by Rotaract Club Zurich International\, where we are pleased to welcome Vincent Menne as our guest speaker. Vincent is a member of the Rotaract Club of Bern and President of CSRL\, with a strong focus on leadership\, Rotaract engagement\, and humanitarian impact.During the evening\, Vincent will share how Rotaract networks and purpose-driven leadership can be transformed into concrete humanitarian action\, drawing on his experience with ShelterBox Switzerland\, where he serves on the board.He will highlight the importance of effective collaboration\, governance\, and fundraising in responding to global emergencies\, and how these elements have enabled the mobilisation of over CHF 1M in the past five years.An evening of learning\, inspiration\, and real-world impact. 🌍General Info The event will take place at Blaue Ente\, located at Kulturareal Mühle Tiefenbrunnen\, Seefeldstrasse 223.We will meet at 7:00 PM\, and the presentation will start at 7:20 PM (30 minutes) followed by dinner.The cost for the main course and a soft drink will be CHF 45–50\, depending on the selected menu.Do not miss it!

DESCRIPTION:Speaker(s): #RAC #Learning #ImpactWe warmly invite you to an inspiring dinner hosted by Rotaract Club Zurich International\, where we are pleased to welcome our guest speaker\, Paolo Rodi. This session will explore high-altitude illnesses from both a medical and public health perspective\, with a focus on the real risks faced by climbers and trekkers worldwide—especially in remote areas where access to care is limited.The talk will include insights from a recent expedition in Argentina\, where a lightweight CPAP-based approach was tested as a potential tool for managing altitude-related conditions in the field. This will serve as a practical example of how innovation can be adapted to extreme environments.The discussion will also examine the Nepalese context\, highlighting the working conditions of guides and porters\, as well as the social and cultural dynamics of mountain tourism. Particular attention will be given to unequal exposure to risk and the broader implications for safety and sustainability in high-altitude regions.Speaker Bio Paolo Rodi Is a medical doctor with a background in trauma and emergency surgery\, currently working in Switzerland. His work focuses on disaster medicine\, global surgery\, and humanitarian health\, with a particular interest in improving access to care in resource-limited settings.He is actively involved in mountain and extreme environment medicine\, combining clinical practice\, research\, and field experience in high-altitude regions such as the Andes and the Himalayas. He is also co-founder of Medical Pirates\, a project aimed at making medical knowledge more accessible through engaging and educational content.We look forward to sharing an evening of insight\, meaningful conversation\, and inspiration with you.General InfoThe event will take place at Blaue Ente\, located at Kulturareal Mühle Tiefenbrunnen\, Seefeldstrasse 223.We will meet at 7:00 PM\, and the presentation will start at 7:20 PM (30 minutes) followed by dinner.The cost for the main course and a soft drink will be CHF 45–50\, depending on the selected menu.Do not miss it! ✨
LOCATION:Blaue Ente\, Kulturareal Mühle Tiefenbrunnen\, Seefeldstrasse 223.

DESCRIPTION:Speaker(s): We warmly invite you to an inspiring dinner hosted by Rotaract Club Zurich International\, where we are pleased to welcome our special guest\, Pejman Madani.

Drawing from his extensive experience at one of the world's leading technology companies\, our speaker will share his perspectives on Oracle and the role of AI in today's world — exploring how Oracle is leading the way in shaping the future of cloud\, innovation\, and intelligent enterprise.  Speaker Bio

Pejman Madani is a distinguished corporate leader and legal strategist based in Zurich. As Chairman of the Board and Head of Legal for Oracle Switzerland\, he orchestrates the strategic and regulatory framework for one of the world's premier cloud and AI providers.

A graduate of the University of St. Gallen (HSG)\, Madani combines deep legal expertise with high-level business management. He is a recognized authority on IT Governance\, Digital Transformation\, and Data Privacy\, consistently featured in the Legal 500 GC Powerlist as one of Switzerland's most influential in-house counsels.

Beyond his executive mandate at Oracle\, he is a dedicated member of Rotary Zurich Circle International\, reflecting his commitment to ethical leadership and global networking. His career is defined by a sharp focus on navigating complex technological shifts while ensuring robust corporate integrity.  We look forward to sharing an evening of insight\, meaningful conversation\, and inspiration with you.

General Info

The event will take place at Blaue Ente\, located at Kulturareal Mühle Tiefenbrunnen\, Seefeldstrasse 223. We will meet at 7:00 PM\, and the presentation will start at 7:20 PM (30 minutes) followed by dinner. The cost for the main course and a soft drink will be CHF 45–50\, depending on the selected menu.
LOCATION:Blaue Ente\, Kulturareal Mühle Tiefenbrunnen\, Seefeldstrasse 223

DESCRIPTION:Speaker(s):  An Evening with Prof. Dr. Royston Flude
Executive Dinner · Rotaract Zürich International

Rotaract Zürich International is honoured to host Prof. Dr. Royston Flude as guest of honour for an intimate Executive Dinner.  A Geneva-based leader whose career bridges enterprise\, education and humanitarian service\, Royston brings:

🔹 President of CSPOC\, a United Nations–accredited NGO in consultative status with ECOSOC\, dedicated to building self-sustaining people\, organisations and communities
🔹 Past President of the Rotary Club of Manchester (founded 1911) and a lifelong Rotarian — former Chairman of the Disaster Relief Rotarian Action Group and Founder Member of Rotary Club Genève International
🔹 Senior Research Fellow at the University of Manchester
🔹 An international speaker on education and sustainability — from the ECOSOC High-Level Segment in New York to the WISE Summit in Doha
🔹 Recently invested as a Knight of the Order of St James

Over dinner\, Royston will share reflections from four decades of purpose-driven leadership — and what Service Above Self can mean for the next generation of leaders.

DESCRIPTION:Speaker(s): We warmly invite you to an inspiring evening hosted by Rotaract Club Zurich International\, where we are delighted to welcome our guest of honour\, Roberto Bilton.

Drawing from his experience at the world’s largest brewer\, our speaker will share his perspectives on global sourcing and the craft of negotiation\, exploring how Anheuser-Busch InBev secures the ingredients behind some of the world’s most beloved beers\, and what it takes to strike deals that span continents\, currencies\, and cultures.  Speaker Bio

Roberto Bilton is a dynamic sourcing and procurement leader based in Switzerland. As Global Sourcing Manager for Adjuncts EMEA at Anheuser-Busch InBev\, he steers the sourcing strategy behind iconic names such as Budweiser\, Corona\, Stella Artois\, and Leffe\, negotiating with suppliers across Europe\, the Middle East\, and Africa from his base in Zug as part of the company’s Global Procurement Office.

His journey spans three continents. Beginning his career in management consulting in São Paulo\, he went on to serve as Chief Operating Officer at CarBraxx\, part of Grupo SHC\, and to lead projects at the Fundação Lemann\, one of Brazil’s most respected foundations\, before pursuing a full-time STEM MBA in Management Science at the prestigious University of Virginia Darden School of Business\, where he was honoured with the Darden School Foundation Scholarship. He also holds a degree in Business Administration from Insper. A former competitive athlete\, Roberto channels the drive to set new records into every negotiation\, pairing sharp strategic instinct with a relentless focus on results.

General Info

The event will take place at Blaue Ente\, located at Kulturareal Mühle Tiefenbrunnen\, Seefeldstrasse 223. We will meet at 7:00 PM\, and the presentation will start at 7:15PM (30 minutes) followed by dinner.

The cost for the main course and a soft drink will be CHF 45–50\, depending on the selected menu.

We look forward to sharing an evening of insight\, meaningful conversation\, and inspiration with you.
LOCATION:Blaue Ente\, Kulturareal Mühle Tiefenbrunnen\, Seefeldstrasse 223
